description: Search job families / roles using searchText input (required) and get their Levels.fyi slugs. Use this to resolve a role name (e.g. "software engineer", "product manager", "data scientist") into the jobFamilySlug the benchmark tools require. Returns matching job families with their slugs. A specific title (e.g. "UX designer") is not a job family: if this returns no matches, use search-role-terms, which returns the title with its job family slug, then search-all. REQUIRED arguments: searchText.

searchText.description: Job family / role name to search for (e.g. "software engineer", "product").

name: search-job-families
